{"step":2,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_onig_search","line":867,"var":"mp","code":"OnigMatchParam *mp = onig_new_match_param();","note":"Regex matching is executed with a fresh Oniguruma match parameter object for the supplied pattern and subject."},
{"step":3,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_exec","line":900,"var":"arg_pattern","code":"re = php_mbregex_compile_pattern(arg_pattern, arg_pattern_len, options, MBREX(current_mbctype), MBREX(regex_default_syntax));","note":"The attacker-controlled regex pattern is compiled, which invokes Oniguruma's parser and optimizer on the input pattern."},
{"step":4,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5441,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"if (d == 0) { qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body); }","note":"During compilation, quantifier tuning inspects the quantified body to classify empty-repeat behavior and memory-node interactions."},
{"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"static enum BodyEmptyType quantifiers_memory_node_info(Node* node)","note":"This recursive analysis walks the regex AST under quantifiers, including lists, alternations, and nested quantifiers, to determine emptiness and memory-node state."},
{"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4904,"var":"NODE_CAR(node)","code":"v = quantifiers_memory_node_info(NODE_CAR(node));","note":"The recursion follows child nodes through the AST; a crafted pattern can force repeated traversal of the same logical capture/quantifier structure."},
{"step":7,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_tree","line":5629,"var":"r","code":"r = tune_quant(node, reg, state, env);","note":"The compiler continues tuning the regex tree after the quantifier analysis, using the computed state to update memory/backtrack metadata."},
{"step":8,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_exec","line":938,"var":"regs","code":"regs = onig_region_new();","note":"A match region is allocated before executing the compiled regex against the attacker-controlled subject string."},
{"step":9,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_onig_search","line":880,"var":"err","code":"err = onig_search_with_param(reg, str, end, start, range, region, option, mp);","note":"The compiled regex is executed; the vulnerable state reached during compilation can later manifest as a heap-use-after-free in Oniguruma's quantifier/memory-node handling."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, separators=(',',':')))
print(p)
